Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium- high heat.
Add the chicken and marinade and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring regularly.

ingredients: 190g raw chicken breast, cut into strips
~1g cornflour mixed with 2 tsp water (½ tsp)

directions: Mix the sliced red pepper, chilli, 2 garlic cloves, smoked paprika, oregano, cumin, lemon juice, honey and olive oil to make the peri-peri marinade.
Coat the chicken thighs in the marinade and leave for 15–30 minutes if time allows.

name: Lemon Pepper Chicken Gnocchi
directions: Mix the chicken with 1 tsp olive oil, 2 tsp lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cook the gnocchi according to the packet instructions, then drain and set aside.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5–6 minutes, until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
